title: GroundTruth sector scores
description: Output of the fusion engine: one ranked score per grid cell, combining the damage layer (Channel 1), VLM findings (Channel 2), and verification-weighted citizen signals (Channel 3). Drives the Triage Queue and the map heat layer, and is the input the brief agent summarises. Recomputed client-side (or in-route) whenever a new signal arrives, so this file is both a committed baseline artifact AND the live in-memory shape.

cell_size_m.description: Edge length of a square cell in metres. One number for the whole grid; changing it invalidates every cell_id.

scheme.description: How cell_id is derived. 'lonlat_floor' means id = f(floor(lon/step), floor(lat/step)) — trivially reproducible in both Python and JS, which matters because the pipeline writes cells and the browser recomputes them.

origin.description: Optional grid anchor, if the scheme needs one.

weights.description: The fusion weights used to produce THIS file. Embedded rather than hardcoded in the reader so a score is reproducible and auditable after the fact — a ranked list nobody can recompute is not evidence. Components should be documented in DECISIONS.md whenever changed.

tier_multipliers.description: Per-verification-tier multipliers applied to citizen/VLM signals before they contribute.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north]. Lets the map draw the cell without recomputing the grid.

rank.description: 1-based position in the Triage Queue, 1 = go here first. Recomputed on every re-score.

score.description: Fused priority, 0..1. Normalised across cells in this file — a score is only meaningful relative to its siblings, so never compare across events or runs.

components.description: The score broken out per channel, each 0..1, BEFORE weighting. Kept so the UI can say why a cell ranks where it does, and so a responder can disagree with our weighting rather than with a black box.

damage.description: Derived from the damage layer by AGGREGATION — damaged_fraction, optionally area-weighted. HASTE gives a hard 0/1 per building, so this fraction is the only honest continuous damage measure we have. Null when the cell has no assessed buildings.

coverage.description: What we could actually see here. A cell with no imagery coverage and no signals is UNKNOWN, not safe — the UI must render those two states differently or the map lies by omission.

in_valid_area.description: Cell intersects HASTE's exported imagery valid-area mask.

evidence.description: Traceability. Every id here must resolve to a real feature or signal, so a click on the Triage Queue can open the exact underlying evidence.

signal_ids.description: All signals scored into this cell, any tier. Suspect signals are listed but contribute ~0 weight.

vlm_finding_ids.description: signal_ids whose channel is vlm_imagery or vlm_photo. Redundant with signal_ids by design — the UI shows imagery findings in their own card.

urgency_max.description: Highest urgency among the cell's non-suspect signals. Null when the cell has only damage-layer evidence.

persons_at_risk_est.description: Sum of stated persons_at_risk across non-suspect signals in this cell. A floor, not an estimate of the true population — signals that did not state a number contribute nothing. Label it as such in the UI.

top_reasons.description: Short human-readable strings the Triage Queue renders as the cell's justification, e.g. '61% of 340 assessed buildings damaged' or '3 independent reports of stranded persons'. Generated by the fusion engine, not the LLM, so the ranking explanation cannot hallucinate.

place_label.description: Best-effort human place name for the cell, from the gazetteer. Responders navigate by name, not by cell_id.
